title: Bijectivity of cumulative-product cochain evaluation
statement: Let $G$ be a compact Hausdorff topological group in universe $u$ and $N$ a topological integer representation in coefficient universe $\max(u,s)$ with discrete coefficient topology. Suppose $\{g:\rho(g)v=v\}$ is open for every $v\in N$. For each $n\geq0$, the concrete additive evaluation map $e_n:H^n\to\operatorname{LC}(G^n,N)$ of [def-sc-homogeneous-cochain-evaluation] is bijective. This assertion contains no compatibility with differentials.

source.place: Tag 0DVG, section-continuous-group-cohomology, displayed inhomogeneous differential and final profinite comparison; parent proof steps 1-3

proof.text: Define an explicit continuous currying map recursively: in degree zero evaluate at the empty tuple; in the next degree precompose with (a,h) mapping to cons(a,h), curry, and postcompose with the previous currying map. Compact-open continuity gives continuity at every step. Induction shows uncurrying the constructed map recovers the given finite-variable continuous function.

source.place: Tag 0DVG, section-continuous-group-cohomology, displayed inhomogeneous differential and final profinite comparison; parent proof steps 1-3

proof.text: Uncurrying is injective by induction and extensionality, evaluating an equality on each tuple cons(a,h). For an invariant homogeneous cochain and arbitrary tuple h, use its diagonal equivariance and the identity h=h_0 times the partial products of successive ratios. Thus equality of cumulative-product coordinates implies equality everywhere, proving injectivity of e_n.

source.place: Tag 0DVG, section-continuous-group-cohomology, displayed inhomogeneous differential and final profinite comparison; parent proof steps 1-3

proof.text: Give N the group action induced by its representation. Mathlib continuousSMul_iff_stabilizer_isOpen makes this action jointly continuous. For a locally constant c, construct the continuous function f(h)=rho(h_0)c((h_i inverse)*h_(i+1)). Curry it explicitly. Cancellation of the common left factor in the ratios shows diagonal equivariance; injectivity of uncurrying makes the iterated map invariant. Fin.partialProd_right_inv shows its evaluation equals c, proving surjectivity. The empty tuple is handled by the degree-zero currying case.
